body.name: V_{cf\ell}
body.space: extended nonnegative real-valued functions of the covariate
body.def: For \(c\in\mathcal C\), fold \(f\), and \(1\le\ell\le d_c\), define the extended path variation directly by \[V_{cf\ell}(x)=\sup_{0=u_0<\cdots<u_m=t_{c\ell}}\sum_{j=1}^m |R_{cf}(u_j\mid x)-R_{cf}(u_{j-1}\mid x)|\in[0,+\infty].\] Under Assumption~\ref{ass:relative-survival-bv}, this equals \(|dR_{cf}(\mathord\cdot\mid x)|((0,t_{c\ell}])\).
